verdict.rationale: telli documents an official MCP server that lets AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, and Codex talk to Charlie, its built-in assistant, over the Model Context Protocol, and a probe confirms the dedicated MCP integration docs page exists. The evidence is a single descriptive sentence plus the probe, so the depth of the integration is not shown. Missing for 10: details on setup, auth, and transport; the scope of exposed tools beyond routing through Charlie; independent or hands-on corroboration.
